name_reason: Compliant: data_fd2_ prefix (game global), ui_slide_anim domain descriptor, accumulator role, buf_ptr data type. No Ghidra address residue (no hex suffix; 64000 is the mode-13h 320x200 framebuffer size, a semantic constant, not address residue). Name accurately reflects use confirmed by disasm: malloc(0xfa00) result stored here and read back as the per-frame interpolated buffer arg.
purpose: BSS pointer to the per-frame interpolated 320x200 (mode 13h) image buffer used by the UI menu slide-in/slide-out transitions; assigned at runtime via malloc(64000) by each opener and free()d on close.
logic_summary: First of three sibling workspace pointers (0x53C5B accumulator, 0x53C5F bg_snapshot, 0x53C63 composed_target). On opening a slide transition each opener does ptr=malloc(64000) for all three, snapshots VGA 0xA0000 into bg_snapshot, copies bg into composed_target, renders the panel/grid/portrait into composed_target, then runs a 12- or 6-frame slide loop passing this accumulator as the per-frame interpolated state to fd2_play_status_screen_outro_step / fd2_slide_panel_down_step (CALL 0x18409 etc.). On close the buffers are free()d. Used by status, portrait, shop, promote, save, spell-select, and chapter-intro/recruitment menu flows.
datatype: uint32 (4-byte pointer slot; Ghidra type undefined4). Holds a void* to a 64000-byte heap buffer at runtime.
element_semantics: Single 4-byte pointer slot. NULL/0 at rest (BSS); holds the malloc(64000) base of the per-frame mode-13h render accumulator while a slide transition is active.
